source.title: NIST Special Publication 800-123: Guide to General Server Security
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
source.applicability: Covers fundamental security practices for network-facing systems. Relevant to diskless client architectures and server-provisioned workstations described in scope keyDescription. Includes sections on patch management (Section 3.1.3), configuration controls (Section 3.2), and operational logging (Section 3.4.4).

passages.text: Testing and applying patches in a timely manner
Remove or disable unnecessary services, applications, and network protocols
Configuring, protecting, and analyzing log files on an ongoing and frequent basis
